proof_body:
by
  have bcf : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : unitInterval) (t : ℝ), MeasureTheory.charFun ((ProbabilityTheory.binomial n p).map (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ))) t = (1 - (p : ℂ) + (p : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ^ n := by
    intro n p t
    rw [MeasureTheory.charFun_apply, MeasureTheory.integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), ProbabilityTheory.integral_binomial, add_comm (1 - (p : ℂ)), add_pow]
    rw [show Finset.Iic n = Finset.range (n + 1) by ext; simp]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    have e : Complex.exp ((inner ℝ (k : ℝ) t : ℝ) * Complex.I) = Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) ^ k := by
      rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1
      simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      push_cast; ring
    rw [e, Complex.real_smul]
    push_cast
    ring
  intro Ω _ P X Y m n p hI hX hY hmX hmY
  have hconv : MeasureTheory.Measure.conv (ProbabilityTheory.binomial m p) (ProbabilityTheory.binomial n p) = ProbabilityTheory.binomial (m + n) p := by
    apply (MeasurableEmbedding.natCast (α := ℝ)).map_injective
    rw [← Nat.coe_castAddMonoidHom, MeasureTheory.Measure.map_conv_addMonoidHom _ (by fun_prop)]
    apply MeasureTheory.Measure.ext_of_charFun
    ext t
    simp only [MeasureTheory.charFun_conv, Nat.coe_castAddMonoidHom, bcf, pow_add]
  rw [← hconv, ← hX, ← hY]
  exact hI.map_add_eq_map_conv_map₀' hmX.aemeasurable hmY.aemeasurable (by rw [hX]; infer_instance) (by rw [hY]; infer_instance)
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℕ) (m n : ℕ) (p : unitInterval), ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X Y P → P.map X = ProbabilityTheory.binomial m p → P.map Y = ProbabilityTheory.binomial n p → Measurable X → Measurable Y → P.map (fun ω => X ω + Y ω) = ProbabilityTheory.binomial (m + n) p
